ruling_scope: Ivan fastlane #9: discard only speech/captions originating inside a watched other-VTuber video; do not repair or subtitle it. No other text, boundary, title, or cover change is authorized.
why_no_drop_is_proven: The retained cue-truth table marks every human_source_verdict and human_action PENDING; its overlap flag is expressly mechanical-only and not a deletion decision.
The retained README requires human playback source/action judgment and forbids treating the package itself as a formal receipt.
The retained record's subtitle SHA does not equal retained current.srt SHA, so neither surface can be silently promoted to a sealed final-text authority.
required_successor_evidence: A candidate/date/hash-bound receipt must identify watched-video playback intervals and independently classify every affected cue or sub-cue as IN_VIDEO, HOST_LIVE, MIXED, or UNCERTAIN. Only complete IN_VIDEO cues may be dropped; mixed cues require an exact sub-cue projection, and UNCERTAIN cues remain frozen.
